subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can understand the story Then and now and match speech bubbles to characters.
I can correct mistakes in sentences about the story.
I can find creative ideas in the story and make my own code.

tf.s: Sami's project is about how things were different in the past.
tf.why: Yes! It's about how things were different ten years ago and more.

tf.s: Sami's parents had a tablet ten years ago.
tf.why: They didn't have a tablet; they had a computer.

tf.s: Over 100 years ago, people in big houses used speaking tubes.
tf.why: Right! A speaking tube worked like a phone.

tf.s: The children make a speaking tube with two bottles.
tf.why: They make it with two cans, a hose and some string.

tf.s: Sound can travel through a tube.
tf.why: Yes! That is how a speaking tube works.

tf.s: Lottie says "Let's use this code mum told me about".
tf.why: Yes! Lottie knows the code from her mum.

tf.s: Over 100 years ago, people used mobile phones to talk to each other.
Making a secret code is a creative idea.
tf.why: Great! Being creative means having new ideas.

tf.s: In the Discovery Team code, you move the last letter to the start.
tf.why: You move the first letter to the end and add ay.

tf.s: The story's value is being lazy.

boxes.q: What do the children use to make a speaking tube?
o: two cans, a hose and some string
boxes.why: Cans, a hose and string make the tube.

boxes.q: What did people in big houses use like a phone 100 years ago?
What did Sami's parents have ten years ago?
boxes.why: They had a computer, but no tablet.

boxes.q: Who says "Let's use this code mum told me about"?
boxes.why: Lottie's mum told her about the code.

boxes.q: "Hello Sami" in the Discovery Team code is ___.
boxes.why: Move the first letter to the end and add ay.

o: making a speaking tube from cans
boxes.why: Making something new from old things is creative.

boxes.q: What travels through the speaking tube?

hunt.q: Who knows the code from mum?

o: How things were different ten years ago and more
mcq.why: The project is about then and now.

mcq.q: Which words are from the story?
o: speaking tube, can, hose, string, code
mcq.why: These are the story words of Then and now.

mcq.q: What is the rule of the Discovery Team code?
o: Move the first letter to the end and add ay.
Change every letter to a number.

mcq.q: What is the value in this story?
Correct: Sami's parents had a tablet ten years ago.
o: They didn't have a tablet; they had a computer.
They had a mobile phone and a tablet.
mcq.why: Ten years ago, they had a computer.

mcq.q: Write "Sami" in the Discovery Team code.
mcq.why: S moves to the end: ami + s + ay = Amisay.

mcq.q: Correct: The children make a speaking tube with two bottles.
o: They make it with two cans.
They make it with two tablets.
They make it with two letters.
They make it with two phones.

mcq.q: Why couldn't you walk around with an old telephone?
o: It stayed in the house; it wasn't mobile.

mcq.q: How does the children's speaking tube work?
o: Sound travels through the hose from one can to the other.

mcq.q: Why is making a secret code a creative idea?
o: The children make something new to send messages.
It is a very old phone.
It is a rule from school.
It is the same as an email.
mcq.why: Creative means thinking of new ideas.
